hyperedges.label: Phastos Performance Optimization Journey
hyperedges.description: All optimization techniques applied across Phastos API framework and ORM, spanning sync handler path optimization, header-based request ID, profile-guided optimizations, GenerateFastID, reflection caching, template caching, multi-layer statement caching, and fast-path architecture.

hyperedges.label: Phastos SSE Subsystem
hyperedges.description: Complete SSE subsystem including token authentication, encrypted token authentication, controller structure, HTTP/3 compatibility handling, SSEHub for connection management, and browser test client.

hyperedges.label: Phastos Monitoring Stack
hyperedges.description: Monitoring providers integrated into Phastos API framework: OpenTelemetry and New Relic, designed to coexist in the same request.
